faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: We operate Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm, and Saturday from 9am to 5pm. Exceptional time slots can be arranged on request.
faq.a2: Yes, we bring all our professional eco-friendly products. You don't need to prepare anything.
faq.a3: Our satisfaction is 100% guaranteed. If the result doesn't meet your expectations, we come back for free within 24 hours.
faq.q4: Can I always have the same agent?
faq.a4: Yes, with our Weekly and Monthly plans, you benefit from a dedicated agent.
faq.a5: We accept bank cards, SEPA direct debit, and mobile payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay).
faq.q6: Can I cancel or modify my booking?
faq.a6: You can cancel or modify your booking up to 24 hours before the service without charge.
